subject: world_language
concept: Holding a short multi-turn conversation combining routines, hobbies, directions, family, and plans
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A2 'sustained simple interaction' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student sequences conversation-phrase cards into a multi-turn coherent exchange
exercise.abstract: Student performs a multi-turn spoken or written conversation combining this unit's skills

assessment.mastery_threshold: conversation includes at least 3 connected turns using vocabulary/structures from this unit
misconception_flags: conversation turns don't logically respond to each other

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
